map_x.claim: Map x equals screen pixels; each [tile] column is 224 wide.
map_x.evidence: E-PARSE: tile IMG canvas 224 wide; right pathgate x is width-15±3 in all lorien maps.

map_y.evidence: E-INFER: pass grid 30 rows x 12 = 360 aligns with the bottom of the 480 tile canvas; up/down pathgate y lands exactly on walkable grid edges in 298/471 of 2488 maps.

pass_grid.claim: 14x30 per tile column, cell 16x12 map units, 0=walkable, 2=blocked
pass_grid.evidence: E-INFER: 92% of 19582 monster spawn points fall on 0 cells; other values unknown.

background_y.claim: Background and tile images use screen space (anchor y=0); dgn [background pos] kept raw.
background_y.evidence: E-UNKNOWN: effect of [background pos] needs original screenshots.

layers.claim: distantback < middleback < bottom < closeback < normal < close; normal is sorted by ground y
layers.evidence: E-INFER from tag names; draw order needs original footage.

scroll.claim: distantback/middleback/close scroll at far/middle/near sight scroll percent and repeat horizontally
scroll.evidence: E-INFER from tag names; repeat behaviour unknown.

greed.claim: Dungeon cell letter minus "A" is a door mask: right=1 up=2 left=4 down=8
greed.evidence: E-INFER: all lorien neighbours are reciprocal; best of 24 bit orders across 328 dgn files.

gate_images.claim: %d%d in gate IMG templates is filled with a zero-prefixed decimal variant from the second [int data] value; first value is state 0=always 1=closed 2=open
gate_images.evidence: E-PARSE: pathgate IMGs name variants 01..09 and 010..012; replacing %d%d with the bare value fails for 10..12, while prefixing zero matches all observed gate families.
